name: Gainsight
summary: Customer success platform whose first-party MCP server connects AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to live Gainsight data. For churn the signal is the vendor's own: Gainsight CS Scorecards (health from product usage and telemetry) and Staircase AI (sentiment and risk mined from email, Slack, meetings and support), which the MCP exposes read-only so an agent can review risk and then act (create CTAs and success plans). OAuth with a PKCE toggle; the server URL is per-tenant ([your-domain].gainsightcloud.com/v1/ds-mcp/mcp), so not keyless-probeable. No churn-flag accuracy figure is published.

payments.notes: Enterprise subscription; the MCP needs a Gainsight CS / Staircase AI plan. No public price page was found (quote-based), so priceList is null and humanBilling is unknown. The MCP has no separate price and speaks no machine-payment protocol.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. The CS MCP URL is per-tenant (https://[your-domain].gainsightcloud.com/v1/ds-mcp/mcp), auth OAuth: an admin creates an OAuth app in Gainsight and enables the PKCE toggle; each user connects under role-based permissions. No fixed public endpoint, so no probe was possible.

jobs.summary: Gainsight computes the churn signal: CS Scorecards (health from usage/telemetry) and Staircase AI risk/sentiment from unstructured communication. A first-party MCP exposes these read-only (Read Scorecards, account briefs) and can create CTAs. No vendor precision/recall, lead-time or saves figure.
